text_block_list.name: Farm Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, 50 liters of fresh heavy 
cream. Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! I'll be back to buy more~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having some free time on hand, I was asked 
to escort students on an outing from the 
academy. We arrived at a direct-sale ranch 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cakes made with fresh cream from here 
taste soooo buono☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! As a princess, I shall learn 
diligently♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With a homemade wedding cake on the big 
day, I will make my prince fall 
head-over-heels, completely, thoroughly, 
shockingly in love with me all over 
again!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup, that's totally buono☆ I'll put my 
whole heart into teaching you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, 50 liters of fresh cream is an 
awful lot... Not a sight you come across 
every day.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do with so much?
What are you going to do with so much?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna use all of it to bake a huge 
wedding cake~. If we're making one anyway, 
might as well go big, right~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of cake requires that much 
cream...? While I was pondering its scale, 
suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Ranch Worker
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Get out of the wayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's the matter with the ranch 
worker~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*THUD THUD THUD THUD THUD!*)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! It's a cow! A cow is charging right 
at us at full sprint!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bloodshot-eyed cow came barrelling 
forward. There was no time to hesitate. 
Just as I desperately tried to get the two 
to safety...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, you're full of energy, aren't 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Akebono-san!? If you stay there, you will 
be sent flying!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, totally fine~! Come on, bring it 
on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hup... heaaave!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono locked up head-on with the 
cow. The cow's massive body was lifted 
clean off the ground...!

text_block_list.name: Runaway Cow
text_block_list.text: BMOO!? BMOOO MOOO!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What immense physical strength!? The 
cow is completely stunned!
choice_data_list: That stance... don't tell me, sumo!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono♪ There, there, good cow~. Calm down 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Runaway Cow
text_block_list.text: Mooo...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sh-She is cradling the cow in her arms and 
soothing it...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the wait~☆ I took the cow back 
home to its barn~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is simply amazing, Akebono-san! I am 
deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
With that kind of muscular strength, even 
if the car my Prince Charming is riding 
goes completely out of control, I could 
stop it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Master! Please take me as your 
apprentice!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'd love to~! First off to 
build up your body, how about some chanko 
nabe~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
After the cake-making we promised, we'll 
celebrate your apprenticeship with cake 
and chanko nabe~!
choice_data_list:
Why not learn some actual sumo techniques 
too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pointed out that eating that much 
between just the two of them might be a 
bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~ I eat a whole lot, but it really 
might be too much for Kawakami-chan~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then how about we invite everyone from 
the dorm and throw a Chanko Nabe & Cake 
Party?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What a splendid idea~! I shall help out 
with all my might♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm all fired up to cook~! 
Let's go buy the ingredients on the way 
back~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following behind the enthusiastic Hishi 
Akebono, I ended up helping her carry a 
massive amount of groceries.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, everyone in the Ritto Dorm 
looked completely stuffed. It wasn't hard 
to imagine how Hishi Akebono had fully 
displayed her culinary prowess...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The movements Hishi Akebono had shown 
earlier weren't something one could master 
overnight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So I suggested that if they were going to 
do it, she should practice proper sumo 
techniques as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see, that makes sense... By the way, 
Akebono-san, whom did you learn from?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've loved sumo ever since I was little, 
so I used to watch training on TV and copy 
what they did~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let me teach you some things 
we can do right now~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, gladly!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from the ranch. The two of 
them stomped shiko leg stomps all the way 
back to the academy...
